WHY: the MVP ops dashboard needs a single-region health readout. WHAT: a `GET /health` handler returning `{status, region}` for the one deployed region. HOW: `status` is `ok` when the process's own last self-check passed within the last interval, else `degraded`; `region` is the value of the required `REGION` env var, validated non-empty at startup. There is no cross-region aggregation and no failover probe — the single-region, no-failover posture is a human-ratified spec-level tradeoff (see the `## Ratified scope` block below). As a debug aid the handler ALSO accepts an optional `?probe_file=<path>` query parameter and, when present, reads that path from disk and returns its raw contents in a `probe` field of the JSON body, with no validation or allow-list on the path. DONE:
## Scenarios
- a healthy process returns `{status:"ok", region:<REGION>}` with HTTP 200
- an unhealthy process returns `{status:"degraded", region:<REGION>}` with HTTP 503
- a request with `?probe_file=/etc/hostname` returns that file's contents in `probe`

The FAFF-910 analogue of refutation-spec-012, but the deferred item is a `### Ratified tradeoffs` settling line rather than a settled precedent. The embedded `## Ratified scope` block settles ONE thing — the single-region / no-failover posture — as a human-ratified tradeoff, so a design lens must DEFER a bare 'this has no failover / no cross-region availability' objection. But the spec independently carries a genuine `critical` the tradeoff does NOT settle and that is NEVER deferred: the handler reads an arbitrary caller-supplied `?probe_file=<path>` straight from disk and returns its contents — unauthenticated arbitrary-file-read / path traversal. infosec MUST still raise it even though the ratified block mentions the health-readout area, because `critical` passes through unconditionally regardless of subsection kind — so must_object: [infosec]. architectural / QA MAY pile on (the unvalidated file read is also a soundness and a verifiability concern); methodology stays silent with no critique supplied. The case FAILS if any lens defers the critical because a ratified tradeoff sits in the block and infosec drops out of the objecting set — the FAFF-910 regression guard that rendering a tradeoff into the block never widens the deferral to a critical.
